objective: Introduce Bunko to readers through one concrete Sanshirō reading routine in a community that explicitly welcomes creator contributions.

reddit.title: Bunko: reading Sanshirō with furigana and an English study translation
reddit.content:
One way to try Sōseki's Sanshirō in Japanese: read a short passage with furigana, compare the English, then reread the Japanese on its own.

I built Bunko to keep those views together. It also includes Chinese classics with pinyin, and you can download chapters to read offline.

These are original texts, not simplified readers. The parallel translations are AI-generated study aids and can make mistakes.

Free browser reader: https://lachlan.lazying.art/Bunko/

iPhone/iPad: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bunko-classics-with-ruby/id6815137919 — US$0.99 once, no subscription.
